title: Asistencia
brief: Simple manual roll call inside the course view: absences counted per class hour (3-hour class = 3 absences), late arrival corrected by the hour the student arrived, absences removed only with a reason (excuse = justified, or 'Sí vino' = list error) and every change kept with its date; every roll call is a dated session. Integrated with the existing course view (sidebar, tokens, Notas/Grupos switch).

artboards.title: Pestaña Asistencia por fecha
artboards.tradeoff: New 'Asistencia' tab: list of dated sessions on the left and that day's per-hour detail with totals on the right. Clear for reviewing one class; comparing a student across dates needs clicking through sessions.

artboards.title: Columna Faltas dentro de Notas
artboards.tradeoff: No new tab: a 'Faltas' column in the grade table and a side panel with the student's timeline and corrections. Best integration with grades; the per-date view of the whole class is weaker.

artboards.title: Matriz de asistencia por fecha
artboards.tradeoff: Students × dates grid in an 'Asistencia' tab: absences per cell with heat color, justified striped, corrected cells marked; click a cell to correct. Most complete overview; gets wide after many classes (scrolls horizontally).

artboards.title: Corregir tocando las horas
artboards.tradeoff: Correction works like taking the roll: tap each hour (with its real time) to toggle F/✓, one-tap shortcuts (vino toda la clase, llegó en la 2.ª/3.ª hora), a required '¿Por qué cambia?' (llegó tarde, tiene excusa, error de lista) and a big Antes → Ahora. Clearer than picking an abstract option first; slightly more on screen.
